in Zul'Aman.]] Pangos, short for pangolins, are hulking beasts covered in armor scales found in Zul'Aman. One small population also lives in Pei-Wu Forest on the Wandering Isle. The forest trolls of Zul'Aman employ pangos as draft animals (in which case they may be termed wagonlins) and mounts. They also cook pango meat as food and craft shields from their thick hides. Kulzi, the loa of medicine, takes the form of a pango. A potent but forbidden healing ritual among the Amani involves sacrificing a pango liver, representing a part of Kulzi's own flesh, in order to beseech the loa for healing. An Amani expression is to "complain like an old pango".
